title: Concrete cylinders: n = 16
intro: A ready-mix plant's concrete has compressive strengths with mean μ = 4200 psi and standard deviation σ = 350 psi. A quality engineer averages the strengths of **n = 16** test cylinders. The standard error is σ/√n = 350/√16 = 87.5 psi, a quarter of σ. Compare with n = 4 in the Learn tab, where it is 175 psi.
